flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Open Settle up and count the payments listed.
Assert Settle up lists exactly two payments.
Assert Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying.
Store The number of payments listed in Settle up, as a digit as 'payment_count'.

remark: type: Typing Ana into Name field
type: Typing Ben into the Name field in the People form
type: Typing Cy in the Name field
click: Clicking Add person button for Ana, Ben and Cy
wait: queued plan (6 steps): type "Bill name"; type "Amount"; click "Ana"; click "Ben"
select: Selecting Ben in Paid by combobox
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Bill name"; type "Amount"; click "Add bill"
scroll: Scrolling down to find the Bills list
wait: PRIMARY: Open Settle up and count the payments listed
analyze: Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments.
assert: Settle up lists exactly two payments.
assert: Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying.

summary:
Started Hati with no saved people or bills.
Added Ana, Ben, and Cy.
Added the Rent bill for 900.00 paid by Ana and split equally among all three people.
Added the Electricity bill for 300.00 paid by Ben and split equally among all three people.
Opened Settle up, which listed two payments: Cy pays Ana 400.00 and Ben pays Ana 100.00.
one_liner: set up shared bills on Hati
